name: Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket: Mega Shine
summary: Get ready to add more Shiny Pokémon to your collection with the latest Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket expansion, Mega Shine, available now! This sparkly new expansion introduces even more fabulous Shiny Pokémon to the game, including Shiny Mega Gengar ex and Shiny Mega Charizard X ex, combining power and charm. Other Shiny Pokémon adding a dazzling touch to your collection include Shiny Pineco, Shiny Ponyta, Shiny Zorua, and Shiny Dragonair.
